question: Given that Ireland’s proposed short-term rental (STR) framework makes access to the national STR registration system conditional upon compliance with planning requirements, does the Commission consider that such a framework may constitute an authorisation scheme within the meaning of Articles 9 and 10 of the Services Directive1?
If so, what criteria would Ireland need to demonstrate are fulfilled to ensure that such restrictions are justified, proportionate, transparent and non-discriminatory?
Directive 2006/123/EC of 12 December 2006 on services in the internal market (ELI: http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2006/123/oj). 1
